This looks like a CBP ruling on a wireless TV speaker system. The system has a transmitter and an amplified speaker module, and it is classified as a unit under heading 8518. The question is which subheading fits.

Candidates:
- 8518.21 covers a single loudspeaker mounted in its enclosure.
- 8518.22 covers multiple loudspeakers mounted in the same enclosure.
- 8518.40 covers audio-frequency electric amplifiers.
- 8518.29 covers other loudspeakers.

The speaker module has two speakers in a single enclosure, which points to 8518.22. The set also includes a transmitter, so the question is whether the system is classified as a whole. GRI 3(b) would make the speaker module the component that gives the set its essential character, so the set goes in 8518.22.

The 10-digit code is 8518.22.0000, the only statistical suffix under that subheading.

{"hts_code": "8518.22.0000", "reason": "The system's essential character comes from the amplified speaker module, which holds two speakers in one enclosure, so under GRI 3(b) the set is classified as multiple loudspeakers mounted in the same enclosure."}
